question: Devdas Smriti Panthi Dance Award is related to which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The ****Devdas Banjare Smriti Panthi Dance** Award is related to the state of** ****Chhattisgarh**. 
 
• This **state-level award** has been **instituted by the Culture Department** in memory of the late** ****Devdas Banjare.**
 
• The** purpose** is to honour participants and institutions in the folk style **'Panthi Nritya'** of Chhattisgarh.
 
• 
 
The award includes a **prize money of Rs 50,000,** a memento, and a citation.

 
 
• 
 
 This award has been included in the state decoration ceremony** organized **on the **occasion of State Foundation Day.**

 
 
• 
 
The manual for the **Devdas Banjare Smriti Panthi Dance Award** was published in the** Gazette on ****September 10, 2021.**

 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• ** Devdas Banjara**

 
 
• **​B****orn on January 1, 1937, **in Sakra Village in Chhattisgarh's Dhamtari District.
 
• Devdas Banjara is **solely responsible for the global fame of the Panthi dance. **
 
• Represented India in various dance festivals.
 
 
• **In 1975 and 1972.**
 
 
• He received the President's and Chief Minister's Gold Medals.
